DECLARE @synchronization_version bigint = ?;
DECLARE @minimumVersion  bigint;
DECLARE @IsReload bit = ?;

SET @minimumVersion  = CHANGE_TRACKING_MIN_VALID_VERSION(OBJECT_ID('dbo.FWFastlabel_ClickAndCollect'))

IF (@synchronization_version < @minimumVersion AND @IsReload  = 0)  RAISERROR('ERROR - Synchronization version invalid', 11, 11);

SELECT 
       Cng.[Id]
      ,Cng.[SYS_CHANGE_VERSION]
      ,Cng.[SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION]
      ,[Label]
      ,[ToContactName]
      ,[ToStreetAddress]
      ,[ToLocality]
      ,[ToStateOrProvince]
      ,[ToPostalCode]
      ,[ToCountry]
      ,[ToPhoneNumber]
      ,[ToEmail]
      ,[WeightDead]
      ,[WeightCubic]
      ,[Length]
      ,[Width]
      ,[Height]
      ,[FromRf]
      ,[FromStreetAddress]
      ,[FromLocality]
      ,[FromStateOrProvince]
      ,[FromPostalCode]
      ,[FromCountry]
      ,[FromPhoneNumber]
      ,[FromEmail]
      ,[CreatedOn]
      ,[CreatedBy]
      ,[Processed]
      ,[ProcessedOn]
  FROM CHANGETABLE (CHANGES FWFastlabel_ClickAndCollect, @synchronization_version) Cng 	
  LEFT JOIN [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[FWFastlabel_ClickAndCollect] AS CNC ON Cng.ID = CNC.Id
  WHERE @IsReload = 0

  UNION
  SELECT
       [Id]
      ,@minimumVersion AS [SYS_CHANGE_VERSION]
      ,'I' AS [SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION]
      ,[Label]
      ,[ToContactName]
      ,[ToStreetAddress]
      ,[ToLocality]
      ,[ToStateOrProvince]
      ,[ToPostalCode]
      ,[ToCountry]
      ,[ToPhoneNumber]
      ,[ToEmail]
      ,[WeightDead]
      ,[WeightCubic]
      ,[Length]
      ,[Width]
      ,[Height]
      ,[FromRf]
      ,[FromStreetAddress]
      ,[FromLocality]
      ,[FromStateOrProvince]
      ,[FromPostalCode]
      ,[FromCountry]
      ,[FromPhoneNumber]
      ,[FromEmail]
      ,[CreatedOn]
      ,[CreatedBy]
      ,[Processed]
      ,[ProcessedOn]
  FROM [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[FWFastlabel_ClickAndCollect] AS CNC
  WHERE @IsReload = 1
